summary: Mikes Knob lookout built 1941 by CCC labor; moved to Richwood VFD station; original hilltop has no tower; not open to the public; county sources disagree.

facts.status_note: Moved to the Richwood Volunteer Fire Department station; the Forest Fire Lookout Association list shows the original hilltop site as Tower Gone

access.note: A 2024 blog post says the tower is not open to the public. It stands at a fire station, so ask the department first

events.note: Register says built in 1941; Forest Lookouts credits Civilian Conservation Corps labor; blog also gives 1941
Register photo caption: fire finder in use at Mikes Knob in 1946
Move date not given. A Register photo caption places the tower atop Richwood VFD in February 2014. Blog says it was moved for preservation
Forest Fire Lookout Association list shows the original Mikes Knob site as Tower Gone. No removal date given

notes_for_editor: Second record for the same tower: us-wv-mikes-knob-tower-site-at-richwood-vfd already has a story and research file. Consider merging the two. The events entry in our record reads 'None relocated (The lookout was moved to Richwood VFD.)', which is garbled; the relocation event above replaces it. The 2008 FFLOS registration date that the other record cites did not appear in the Register page as cached, so it is not used here. The firetower.org Richwood VFD page returned 404. No staffing or fire history appears in the sources read.
